entities.summary: Charlemagne, a notable figure in the history of Belgium, associated with Frankish Kingdoms & Carolingian Heartland (751–987). Preceded by Treaty of Verdun and Merovingian. Their legacy influenced Treaty of Verdun divides the Carolingian Empire.
